_truth: Session bookkeeping ONLY. This file is NOT a record of what has been imported. Ground truth for 'is this watch already on the site' is the 3ceasuri.ro admin (queried per post via ?q=<id>); ground truth for 'what happened locally' is history.jsonl (append-only). Never derive an import count from this file.
note: 2026-08-13 (session 11): OLX classic wrist watches (category 1677), restricted to seller location București or Ilfov. Complete: 50/50 imported, admin 235 -> 285. Discovery needed a second, wider NO_DEDUP=1 sweep (MAX_CANDIDATES=300, MAX_PAGES=30) after the first 150-candidate pool only yielded 37 unhandled B/I candidates; cross-referenced against history.jsonl locally to skip ids already handled, since Stage-1 dedup with a large candidate count hangs (see below). 21 new brands created this session: Accurist(91), Hugo Boss(92), Police(93), Swatch(94), Super Speed V6(95), Corum(96), IWC(97), Sinn(98), Capuer(99), Vostok Europe(100), Philip Watch(101), Stuhrling Original(102), Adidas(103), Emporio Armani(104), Unique(105), Frederique Constant(106), Fortis(107), Skagen(108), Tecnotempo(109) — all synced to BRAND_IDS + brand-ids.md, committed individually. Skipped 8: ad 294330487 and 307482849 (Rolex, 1 photo each), ad 291380544 'Audemarsk' and ad 307338450 'OMEEGA' (counterfeits — brand names deliberately misspelled to evade filters while copying a genuine design/case), ad 298220055 (pocket watch), ad 303398395 (bulk listing of several Tissot models in one ad), ad 307621509 and 307620296 (two Ulysse Nardin listings from seller 'Time', both implausibly cheap). Blocklisted OLX seller 1380774246 ('Mihail') after a third counterfeit from the same account (OMEEGA) matched the boilerplate text of two other fakes already skipped this session (Hublot, Pateek Philiippe). Two brand-name corrections made from photo evidence contradicting the ad title: 'Armani Exchange' -> Emporio Armani (ad 301201897, box/dial read Emporio Armani) and 'Daniel Klein T5' -> Unique (ad 307997777, dial/caseback read UNIQUE). One Sinn 556i (ad 302208145) had OLX's brand dropdown wrongly set to Longines, picked up from a trade-preference line at the end of the ad. Several listings shared a bare model line name with watches already on the site (Omega Speedmaster Triple Date, AP Royal Oak Offshore, Rolex GMT-Master II) and hit the hard repost-skip dedup, which has no CONFIRM override for a 'strong' match — resolved by folding a genuine distinguishing detail (reference, dial color, box status) into the model string.
